errors.notFound: The requested item was not found.

fieldReasons.out_of_range: This value is out of range.
fieldReasons.invalid_format: This value has an invalid format.
fieldReasons.duplicate: This value is already in use.

session.body: This management demonstration opens with a one-time launch code issued by the local application.
session.mockHint: Simulated mode: a synthetic code has been generated for you.
session.liveHint: Normally supplied automatically by the launch link.
session.codeRejected: This launch code is invalid, expired or has already been used. Request a new one from the local application.
session.ended: Session ended — reopen the demo from the launcher.

overview.title: Quality overview
overview.scopeAll: All agents · pooled across every evaluated call.

agent.title: Agent performance
agent.rescoreCaption: Every evaluation is kept; changes are shown against the previous evaluation of the same call.

kpi.label: Key figures
kpi.averageNote: Based on {n} calls · exact mean, rounded down

sample.title: Sample only — n = {n} scored calls. Not a performance ranking.
sample.body: Synthetic demonstration data. Results stay labelled as a sample until an approved reporting policy defines when agent results are reliable.

versions.title: Evaluations use scorecard versions {versions}.
versions.body: Criteria are matched by id across versions; weights and thresholds may differ. Low-score calls use each version's own threshold. Filter by version to compare like with like, or re-score calls to apply the latest version.

criteria.title: Criterion performance
criteria.caption: Normalized to 10 from actual points · threshold {threshold} (v{version})

agents.title: Agent pages
agents.caption: Open an individual agent page for that agent’s own results. Agents are listed alphabetically; they are not compared or ranked.

status.retireBody: Retirement is permanent. The agent can no longer be selected for uploads and cannot be reactivated, renamed or deleted. Earlier calls, evaluations and history keep this agent.

admin.title: Agents
admin.description: Manage agent profiles, Yeastar extensions and queue assignments. Designed for seven or more agents.
admin.syntheticBody: Names and SYN- extensions are fictional placeholders until the real Yeastar extension numbers are supplied.

form.extensionHint: 2–20 letters, digits or hyphens. Must be unique.
form.syntheticNote: Use fictional names and synthetic extensions only.

errors.extensionTaken: This extension is already assigned to another agent.
errors.nameTaken: This name is already used by another agent, including retired agents.

form.immutableNote: Names cannot be changed later. To rename an agent, retire it and create a new one.

page.title: Calls
page.description: Upload synthetic recordings and review transcripts, evidence and evaluations.

processing.title: Processing
processing.simulated: Simulated in the browser — the real backend transcribes and scores.

failure.rejected: The file was rejected when it was checked. Upload a supported WAV file.
failure.transcription_failed: Transcription failed. No transcript or evaluation was produced.
failure.evaluation_failed: Evaluation failed. No evaluation run was created and no score is shown.

player.title: Recording
player.syntheticAudio: Synthetic audio generated for the demo (tones aligned to the transcript). No real recording.
player.unavailableBody: Uploaded audio is kept in this browser tab only and is not stored by the simulated backend.
player.error: The recording could not be played.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.note: Shortcuts work anywhere on this page except while typing, such as in transcript search. Keys refer to their position on the keyboard, so they also work with an Arabic layout.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.caption: Select a line to play from that moment.
transcript.pending: The transcript will appear when processing reaches this stage.
transcript.olderRevision: This evaluation was scored on an earlier transcript revision, shown here. A newer revision exists and has not been scored.

upload.description: Add a synthetic recording for transcription and scoring.
upload.syntheticBody: Do not upload PBX exports or customer recordings. In this demo, processing is simulated and the file stays in your browser.
upload.title: Display name
upload.confirm: I confirm this recording is synthetic and contains no customer data.

errors.fileSize: The file is larger than 25 MB.
errors.agentRequired: Select the agent who handled the call.
errors.confirmRequired: Confirm that the recording is synthetic.
errors.agent_unknown: The selected agent does not exist. Choose an agent from the list.
errors.agent_retired: The selected agent is retired. Choose an active agent.

upload.channelMapHint: Which stereo channel carries the agent.

channel.mixedBody: Speaker labels and agent attribution are not assumed until supported by evidence. Behaviour criteria may be insufficient and prohibited expressions are only flagged for review.

reasons.segment_missing: The cited transcript line was not found.
reasons.revision_mismatch: The evidence refers to a different transcript revision than the one shown.
reasons.transcript_loading: The transcript is still loading. Try again in a moment.

evaluations.title: Evaluation
evaluations.caption: Scorecard v{version} · {date}

prohibited.title: Prohibited expressions
prohibited.note: Expressions affect the score only under the scorecard's approved penalty rule and when reliably attributed to the agent; otherwise they are flagged for review.

history.title: Evaluation history
history.caption: {n} immutable evaluations · compare any two
history.single: Only one evaluation so far. Re-score to compare versions.

compare.title: Previous versus new
compare.pickTwo: Select two different evaluations to compare.
compare.versionChanged: Scorecard changed from v{from} to v{to}.

page.title: Evaluations
page.description: All evaluations and re-scoring results. History is immutable.

insufficient.title: Insufficient evidence — No score
insufficient.body: {assessable} of {possible} points could be assessed; at least {minimum} are required. Excluded from scored averages and low-score counts.

evaluations.awardedSummary: {awarded} of {assessable} assessable points ({possible} on the scorecard) · normalized to 10
evaluations.reasonMissing: No reason was provided for this result.

notAssessableOverall.title: Not assessable — No score
notAssessableOverall.body: No criterion could be assessed, so no score is given. At least {minimum} assessable points are required. Excluded from scored averages and low-score counts.

evaluations.evidenceUnresolved: Line {id} (not in the transcript revision shown)

page.title: Quality scorecard
page.description: Configure criteria, weights, the low-score threshold and prohibited expressions. Every save creates a new version.
page.placeholderBody: Six approved criteria worth 10 points, minimum 6 assessable points, low score below 7.00. Criteria, points, partial credit, minimum evidence and threshold stay configurable.
page.activeUnknown: Which version is active is not yet reported by the server. The latest saved version is shown; activation status will appear once the API provides it.

editor.title: {name} — editing from v{version}
editor.caption: Criteria are scored in actual points; the evaluation score is normalized to 10.

general.title: General
general.thresholdHint: Calls strictly below this value are low-scoring. Default 7.00.
general.minimumAssessableHint: Below this the evaluation is “Insufficient evidence — No score”. Approved: 6.

criteria.title: Criteria ({n})
criteria.rule: Overall score = awarded points ÷ assessable points × 10, shown to two decimals and rounded down. Not-assessable and insufficient-evidence criteria are excluded; below the minimum assessable points the evaluation gets no score.
criteria.partialCredit: Allow partial credit (any whole number of points)

prohibited.title: Prohibited expressions
prohibited.hint: Matched in transcripts and reported with evidence on each evaluation.

save.immutable: Saving creates version v{next}. Existing evaluations keep their version; re-score calls to apply it.

errors.name: Enter the name in both languages.
errors.threshold: Use a value from 0 to 10 with at most two decimals.
errors.label: Required.
errors.phraseEmpty: Enter the expression or remove it.
errors.minimumAssessable: Use a whole number from 1 to the total points.
errors.penaltyCriterion: Choose the criterion the penalty is deducted from.
errors.penaltyPartialCredit: Penalties can only target criteria that allow partial credit.

history.title: Version history
history.caption: Versions are immutable. Expand a version to see its configuration.
history.counts: {criteria} criteria · {points} points · minimum {minimum} assessable · {expressions} prohibited expressions
history.penaltyNone: Prohibited expressions: flag for review only
history.penaltyActive: Prohibited expressions: deduct {points} points from “{criterion}” when reliably attributed to the agent
history.penaltyActiveOne: Prohibited expressions: deduct {points} point from “{criterion}” when reliably attributed to the agent

penalty.title: Prohibited-expression penalty rule
penalty.pointsHint: 0 = flag for review only (no approved penalty rule).
penalty.note: Applied only when the expression is reliably attributed to the agent (separate channels). Otherwise it is flagged for review.

page.title: Settings
page.description: Display preferences and demo information. Production settings are managed here too as they become available.

reporting.title: Reporting rules
reporting.caption: Applied to every dashboard
reporting.sampleWarningsValue: Always shown — no reporting policy has been approved yet.
reporting.roundingValue: Two decimals, always rounded down. Low score: strictly below the threshold.
reporting.minimumValue: At least the scorecard's minimum assessable points (approved: 6 of 10); otherwise “Insufficient evidence — No score”.

demo.title: Synthetic demo data
demo.caption: Simulated backend only
demo.body: Changes made in this demo are stored in this browser. Resetting restores the original 4 agents, 5 calls and evaluations.
demo.confirmBody: All simulated changes (agents, uploads, scorecard versions, re-scores) will be discarded.

planned.title: Planned administration areas
planned.description: Production requirements recorded for later. Every area will be fully manageable in this interface — no command line, database or file editing.
planned.noticeTitle: Not part of the five-call demo
planned.noticeBody: Each area will include validation, permissions, feedback and audit history.
planned.cardCaption: PBX, AI, reports, users and security, storage, system health and branding

pbx.title: PBX connections and call ingestion
pbx.scope: Yeastar connection setup and testing, ingestion schedule and status, retry of failed ingestion, CDR import for missed, abandoned and SLA metrics.

ai.title: AI models and processing
ai.scope: Model selection, versioned prompts, Iraqi dialect dictionary and processing controls (pause, resume, priority, re-run).

reports.title: Reports, exports and notifications
reports.scope: Scheduled and on-demand reports, CSV/XLSX/PDF exports, email notification rules with a test send.

security.title: Users, roles, MFA and security
security.scope: Users and roles, permissions, MFA enrolment and reset, session policies and the security audit log.

storage.title: Storage, retention, backup and restore
storage.scope: Storage usage, retention policies, backup schedules and verified restore.

health.title: System health and diagnostics
health.scope: Service health, error log browser, diagnostics bundle and general application settings.

branding.title: Branding and localization
branding.scope: Logo upload, brand colours with contrast validation, default language and theme, translation management.
